**Summary: User experience and privacy streamlined; historical and identification logic migrated to automatic system-level handling.**

- Removed all requirements for users to provide, view, or understand internal identity (open-id) parameters; identity association is now automatic and invisible to users.
- Eliminated any prompts or error messages relating to user identity—privacy and simplicity improved.
- Updated documentation and workflow to reflect that all history/report queries are system-handled and always use cloud APIs; local memory/manual summaries strictly forbidden.
- Made historical report lookup and display purely driven by user intent ("show report/history/clearing"), with output always as Markdown tables directly from API data.
- Internal configuration and API-service linkage clarified; scripting and command-line usage examples updated for easier, less error-prone operation.
- Old local API logic and redundant documents removed; references and script locations updated for clarity.

- Updated open-id retrieval sequence: now checks skill directory config.yaml before shared directory config.yaml.
- Clarified config file path: scripts/config.yaml is now the primary location for skill-specific configuration.
- Removed the requirement and logic for sign-in API call (首次签到) when receiving open-id.
- Updated SKILL.md workflow steps, removing redundant sign-in flow and refining key constraints.
- Unified terminology and improved instructions on open-id acquisition for analysis requests.
- Removed obsolete file: skill-card.md.

## smyx-pet-hospital-waiting-anxiety-analysis 1.0.3

- No code or documentation changes detected compared to the previous version.
- No new features, fixes, or updates in this release.

- No user-facing changes; documentation and specification remain the same.
- Version incremented to 1.0.2; no file or functional updates detected.

- Introduced strict open-id validation and first-time sign-in flow, requiring explicit user input and service-side registration before analysis.
- Added rules to prevent open-id guessing, re-use, or skipping open-id checks; scripts now enforce pausing if open-id is missing or not directly provided by the user.
- Integrated a new mechanism for open-id check-in (`track_open_id_received.py`) before any analysis or list operations, only under specific user-reply scenarios.
- Updated documentation to describe the open-id acquisition and check-in flow, with detailed conditions and prohibitions.
- Added a license field ("MIT-0") to SKILL.md.
- Removed an unused file (skill-card.md).

Initial release of pet hospital waiting area anxiety analysis skill.

- Analyze pet behavior in waiting area videos (local file or URL) for anxiety signals: open-mouth panting, trembling, ear position, etc.
- Outputs standardized anxiety level (1-5) to assist medical staff in identifying and prioritizing high-stress pets.
- Strict process for open-id acquisition before any action; only cloud API used for analysis and history, never local memory.
- Supports keyword triggers for historical report lookup; outputs results in Markdown tables with clickable report links.
- Does not diagnose diseases or prescribe treatment—purely an analysis and workflow support tool.
